properties.notes: CLOSED TO PANNING. Swimming and camping site inside the corridor, but gold panning is specifically not allowed here. Good basecamp; pan upstream or down.

properties.name: Calapooia River — NF-2820 lower pullouts
properties.notes: Forest Road 2820 runs beside the river above Holley. Access is a string of small pullouts - park and walk to fresh gravel. Holley blue, carnelian, jasper and wood all come out of this stretch. Surrounding ground is private timber, so stay on the road prism and the wetted gravel.

properties.name: Calapooia River — upper NF-2820 / Weyerhaeuser gate
properties.notes: Gravel road ends at Weyerhaeuser gates. Park along the road and walk in. Low water late summer into early fall is the whole game - bars are under otherwise.

properties.name: Quartz Creek confluence — upper Calapooia
properties.notes: APPROXIMATE AND UNVERIFIED. Tributary confluence in the upper Calapooia drainage, Willamette NF ground. Named for quartz veining in the surrounding Western Cascades volcanics. This is a lead to scout, not a destination.

properties.name: Pioneer Park — Calapooia at Brownsville
properties.notes: City park with easy legal river access at the bottom of the drainage. Picked over and the material runs small, but it is open ground with a bathroom and no gate - a decent first read on what the river carries.
